headline: Brokerages issue buy ratings for Reliance, Ethos, and others
summary: ET Now has compiled a list of stock recommendations from various brokerages for the trading session on October 1. The list includes Reliance Industries, Ethos, Venus Pipes, and Max Healthcare. These recommendations are based on technical and fundamental analysis provided by market analysts. Retail investors should evaluate these picks against their own risk appetite and portfolio strategy.
why_it_matters: Brokerage picks may influence short-term price volatility for these stocks.

headline: Venus Pipes & Tubes issues corrigendum for upcoming EGM
hook: Correction issued for upcoming meeting notice
summary: Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited has issued a corrigendum to the notice of its Extra Ordinary General Meeting scheduled for October 08, 2026. The company submitted this routine administrative correction to the stock exchanges. No further details regarding the nature of the correction were disclosed in the filing. Indian retail shareholders tracking corporate governance and meeting agendas should take note of the updated documentation.
whats_next: Extra Ordinary General Meeting on October 08, 2026
why_it_matters: Routine administrative update with no direct impact on share price
